info.name: UN Comtrade Data Bulk Download Tariffline Data API

params.name: typeCode
params.description: Trade type: C for Goods (Commodities), S for Services

params.name: freqCode
params.description: Reporting frequency: A for Annual, M for Monthly

params.name: clCode
params.description: Commodity classification code: HS (latest), H5–H0 (HS revisions), S4–S0 (SITC revisions), B4/B3 (BEC), EB02 (Extended BEC)

params.name: reporterCode
params.description: UN M49 numeric country code for the reporting country. Comma-separated for multiple. E.g. 156 for China, 840 for USA.

params.name: period
params.description: Year (YYYY for annual) or year-month (YYYYMM for monthly). Multiple values comma-separated, max 12 values.

params.name: cmdCode
params.description: Commodity code(s), comma-separated. Use TOTAL for aggregate.

params.name: partnerCode
params.description: UN M49 numeric country code for the partner country. Use 0 for World.

params.name: flowCode
params.description: Trade flow: M=Import, X=Export, MIP=Import in-transit, XIP=Export in-transit, MOP=Import of goods for outward processing, XOP=Export for outward processing, RM=Re-import, RX=Re-export

params.name: format
params.description: Response format: json (default), csv, or txt

params.name: includeDesc
params.description: Include commodity and country description labels in the response.

items.docs: Extract tariffline-level trade data with full 6-digit HS or national commodity code detail. Provides more granular breakdown than final aggregated data. Requires a valid API subscription key.
